items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 24:1
items.html: Its extension from below upward is called the Malchuyot of YESHSUT [Yisrael-Sava and Tevuna], which emerged through the screen of the aspect of root, whose level reaches Malchut. And its extension from above downward expanded into the seventh king, which is Malchut. It is the aspect of Nefesh of Neshama of ZA. (p. 527, Item 47)
